title: ALMA Measures Rapidly Depleted Molecular Gas Reservoirs in Massive Quiescent Galaxies at z ∼ 1.5
question: How much molecular gas (CO(2–1)) do massive quiescent galaxies at z~1.5 retain, and what does this imply for quenching, depletion times and models?

data.sensitivity: 50-65 uJy/beam per 400 km/s channel; continuum ~5-9 uJy/beam

what.value: Pilot galaxy 21434 CO(2–1) ALMA data, rescaled to r21=0.8

evidence.quote: We combine the results from this program with ALMA data for one similar galaxy from a previous pilot program

what.value: UV+IR SFRs from the UltraVISTA catalog

evidence.quote: SFR$_{\rm UV+IR}$ values correspond to those published by the ULTRAVISTA survey

what.value: Literature gas fractions (PHIBSS, ASPECS, local surveys, Gobat2018 stack, etc.) for comparison

evidence.quote: we compile measurements of molecular gas using CO as a tracer from the literature across redshifts.

recipe.goal: Refit SEDs for stellar mass, SFR, age
recipe.method: Prospector (modified Prospector-alpha, non-parametric SFH, no AGN or dust emission) on UV–near-IR photometry
assumptions: Chabrier IMF; flat LCDM H0=70, Om=0.3

recipe.method: fit point sources to visibilities with channels averaged to 50–800 km/s; position fixed at phase center; two point sources for 22260 and 34879

recipe.goal: Measure line flux or upper limits and convert to L'CO and M_H2
recipe.method: Gaussian fit for detection; upper limits from channel noise with FWHM 500–600 km/s; convert with r21=0.8 and alpha_CO=4.4
assumptions: stellar velocity dispersion sets gas linewidth; Milky Way alpha_CO

recipe.method: weighted mean of 400 km/s channel maps (non-PB-corrected) at CO(2–1) rest frequency of each galaxy

recipe.goal: Compare gas fractions with scaling relations, toy models, bathtub models and SIMBA
recipe.method: closed-box toy models with constant and varying t_dep (Tacconi2018, Liu2019); Dave2012 equilibrium model with Behroozi2010 halo mass via HALOTOOLS; SIMBA selection at z~1.5
key_parameters: 30% mass return to ISM in constant-t_dep model; none in varying model

evidence.quote: this puts a 3$\sigma$ upper limit on the molecular gas fraction of 1.6%
an rms noise limit of 25.6$\mu$Jy/beam for the 400 km/s channel width of the stack
We estimate an upper limit to the typical depletion time of $t_{\rm{dep}}$$<0.6$ Gyr

not_stated_but_needed: Exact tclean/CASA version and task parameters (robust, niter, threshold per source)
Precise line-free channels and continuum subtraction method
Positions of offset sources fixed in uvmultifit for 22260 and 34879
Exact velocity widths used per galaxy for upper limits
Prospector configuration details beyond default priors
Model parameters for the bathtub and toy-model calculations
SIMBA selection details and halo mass assignments
missing_for_reproduction: Exact imaging parameters and CASA version
Details of toy-model and bathtub implementations
score_reason: Public data and simple analysis, but imaging and modelling details are thin.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, simple point-source extraction, numeric limits; but some settings missing.
